ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the Eastern US shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.46): the estimate is +0.030 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.046 to +0.109). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in the Eastern US shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.97): the estimate is −0.0001 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0079 to +0.0077). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
